text:
deploybot: kickstarting staged rollout v2026-03-15-rc4 -> 10% eu-west at 09:17 UTC. monitors: p95, 5xx, kv-evict-rate. status: IN_PROGRESS
kevin: noticing p95 jump in eu-west within 90s, from ~180ms -> 410ms. not huge error rate yet but tail is spiking.
maya: i'm seeing corresponding increase in kv-cache evictions on pool infer-eu-3. logs show repeated kvcache.reclaim calls.
oliver: which model shard? any sequence-length correlation?
kevin: model=openlm-l7-q4b; route=text-gen-alpha. high seqs provoke it, yes. short seqs look fine.
tia: ops, can we hold at 10% and drain if infra sees OOM traces? prefer to delay ramp to 25%.
opsbot: quick consensus poll: pause rollout? react :+1: for pause, :-1: for continue.
kevin: +1 pause. this smells like a cache sizing regression in rc4.
maya: +1 pause. I'll pull heap traces from the affected worker.
oliver: +1 pause. also suggest pinning eu-west to v2026-03-01-stable until root cause identified.
deploybot: current health: 5xx rate 0.35% (baseline 0.12%), p95 +128%. executing pause if consensus reached.
opsbot: votes: 4 pause, 0 continue. initiating pause and routing pin.
deploybot: pause applied. routing pinned: eu-west -> v2026-03-01-stable. canary drained from 10% -> 0%.
deploybot: audit note: action=paused; rollout=v2026-03-15-rc4; region=eu-west; reason="kv-cache eviction surge causing tail latency"
opsbot: infra notes: found one worker with repeated NVML OOM logs, restarted process and increased kvcache max by 20% on pool infer-eu-3. will monitor.
maya: started a focused loadtest (2k long-seq requests) against rc4 replica to repro.
kevin: also running an eval with 500 long prompts to capture traces and latency histogram.
tia: can someone create a ticket for QA + infra to follow up? include reproducer and config diffs between rc3 and rc4.
oliver: created ticket REL-1302 and assigned to maya & infra. priority=P1.
deploybot: rollout audit updated: ticket=REL-1302.
opsbot: timeline summary: pause at +1m10s, worker restart +3m, kvcache tweak +4m30s, drain complete +5m. health trending toward baseline.
maya: early loadtest results: rc4 still shows periodic p95 spikes when kvcache fills beyond 85% capacity. attaching traces in ticket.
kevin: ok. based on these, i'm 👍 staying paused. suggest we keep rc4 blocked until a kvcache fix or fallback quant path is implemented.
tia: agree. adding note to release notes draft: "Canary for rc4 paused in eu-west due to kvcache pressure; draining to stable and investigation opened (REL-1302)." short, customer-facing wording.
oliver: we'll also schedule a brief postmortem once fix merged. ops: please post the offramp plan here when available.
opsbot: postmortem placeholder created: PM-RELEASE-RC4.
deploybot: thread closed for now but remains open for updates. keep replies here.
(automated) opsbot: audit: action=paused; region=eu-west; rollout=v2026-03-15-rc4; ticket=REL-1302; note="kvcache eviction surge -> tail latency"
